summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for acute kidney injury with a creatinine rise from 1.1 to 5.0, attributed to cast nephropathy secondary to relapsed multiple myeloma. He was started on CyBorD chemotherapy and underwent three sessions of plasmapheresis, which led to improvement in renal function, with creatinine decreasing to 2.6 at discharge. He received continuous IV fluids and had a temporary pheresis line placed. His blood pressure was managed with uptitration of carvedilol and diltiazem and addition of doxazosin. Insulin was increased to 46 units of Lantus due to steroid-induced hyperglycemia. Oral vancomycin was continued on a taper for recurrent C. diff. He remained stable, avoided dialysis, and was discharged home with follow-up in oncology, nephrology, and endocrinology.
